mapper.select: SELECT ID, USER_ID, CYCLE_ID, FINAL_SCORE, FINAL_RATING, CALCULATION_SNAPSHOT, EVALUATION_COMMENTS, EVALUATION_SUPERVISOR_COMMENTS, EVALUATOR_ID, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY, DELETED_AT FROM USER_KPI_SUMMARIES WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND CYCLE_ID = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_KPI_SUMMARIES ( ID, USER_ID, CYCLE_ID, EVALUATION_SUPERVISOR_COMMENTS, EVALUATOR_ID, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{comments}, #{evaluatorId, jdbcType=OTHER}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=OTHER} )
